QuestInfo.name: Nex the Time Guard
QuestInfo.0: Andy the Time Traveler says he has something to tell you before your third time travel.
QuestInfo.1: Andy the Time Traveler has informed you that you must pass the test Nex the Gatekeeper of Time, who lives in the Old Tree of Tera, gives you before embarking on your third time travel. Enter the Old Tree of Tera and pass Nex's test.
QuestInfo.2: You have passed the third test given by Nex the Gatekeeper of Time and earned the right to travel to another time. You can now teleport to the Bombed City Center in the year 2099. Go to the Time Gate with the Time Traveler's Pocket Watch.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
EXP 106,900
Can proceed to the 'Identity of the Missile' quest
Can proceed to the 'Rambunctious Robots' quest

0.0: Before your third time travel, you must pass Nex's test again. Don't get too comfortable, though. Nex will be even stronger this time around.

yes.0: When you defeat Nex, the Time Gate to the year 2215 will open.

no.0: You won't be authorized to travel through time unless you defeat Nex the Gatekeeper of Time.

1.0: Ah, you've passed Nex's third test. Now then, you should be able to access the Time Gate to the year 2215.

yes.0: Take the Time Traveler's Pocket Watch and go through the Time Gate.

mob.0: Come back after you've passed Nex's test. Nex the Gatekeeper of Time lives inside the Old Tree of Tera.
